interface Box<T> { next: T }
interface Loop { next: Loop }
type Short = Box<Short1>;
type Short1 = Box<Short2>;
type Short2 = Box<string>;
type Inline = Box<Box<Box<Box<Box<Box<string>>>>>>;
const short: Short = { next: { next: { next: 'short' } } };
const inline: Inline = { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: 'inline' } } } } } };
const shortLoop: Loop = short;
const inlineLoop: Loop = inline;
